layers.name: MOLA Color Shaded Relief
layers.title: MGS MOLA Colorized Shaded Relief Global 463m
layers.coverage: Global (-180 to 180 deg E, -90 to 90 deg N)
layers.source: NASA / GSFC / JPL Solar System Treks
layers.citation: Smith, D. E., et al. (2001). Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter: Experiment overview and selected results. J. Geophys. Res., 106(E10), 23689-23722.
layers.description: Global elevation shaded relief derived from MOLA topography data combined with shaded relief, providing intuitive visual context of Martian morphology and elevation gradients.

layers.name: CTX Global Visible Mosaic
layers.title: MRO CTX Global Grayscale Mosaic (~6m)
layers.citation: Malin, M. C., et al. (2007). Context Camera Investigation on board the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter. J. Geophys. Res., 112, E05S04.
layers.description: Sub-decameter global visible imaging mosaic. Provides high-resolution geomorphological detail of crater ejecta, bedrock outcrops, dunes, and candidate rover traverse hazards.

layers.name: Viking MDIM 2.1 Color Mosaic
layers.title: Viking Mars Digital Image Mosaic 2.1 (232m)
layers.source: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA PDS
layers.citation: Archinal, B. A., et al. (2004). Mars Digital Image Mosaic 2.1. USGS Open-File Report.
layers.description: True-color global mosaic synthesized from red, green, and clear filter Viking imagery with photometrically corrected albedo for natural planetwide exploration.

layers.name: MOLA Topographic Elevation DEM
layers.title: MGS MOLA Global Topography Elevation Model 463m
layers.citation: Zuber, M. T., et al. (1992). The Mars Observer laser altimeter investigation. J. Geophys. Res., 97(E5), 7781-7797.
layers.description: Global numerical areoid-referenced elevation map rendered as visual WMTS tiles via NASA Solar System Treks. Requires internet access. Note: In this release, visual WMTS map tiles provide visual context only and are not queried for numerical route elevation sampling.
